class.name: AudioSystem
class.brief_description: High-capacity spatial audio management for the ECS world.
class.description: [AudioSystem] handles the complex task of spatializing and managing audio for thousands of entities. Standard [AudioStreamPlayer3D] nodes are too heavy for massive scale; instead, the [AudioSystem] pushes spatial data (position, velocity, attenuation) directly to the [AudioServer] using low-level voices. This system integrates with the [OctreeSystem] to perform [b]Audio Culling[/b]. Sounds that are beyond the listener's maximum range or outside the current "Audio Frustum" are automatically silenced or de-prioritized to save CPU mixing cycles. [b]Recommended Workflow:[/b] Attach an [AudioComponent] to an entity to mark it as a sound emitter. The [AudioSystem] will then manage the lifecycle of the underlying audio voice.

method.name: play_spatial_sound
method.description: Triggers an immediate playback of an audio [param stream] at the entity's current world coordinates. This is a "fire and forget" method for SFX like explosions or footsteps. For long-running loops, use the component-based property approach.

method.name: process_audio_updates
method.description: Updates the world transforms and doppler-shift parameters for all active audio voices based on the latest entity transforms.
